hypotheses.title: Supply Chain Inverted Customer Return Spillover (pv13_custretsig_retsig, 10d) (pv13)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits supply chain information transmission and customer return shock overreaction using Revere relationship linkages (pv13_custretsig_retsig, 93% coverage). In earlier testing (candidate c88a5b5e), the un-inverted signal produced an inverted Sharpe of -1.48, demonstrating an extraordinarily strong inverted predictability (Sharpe +1.48). When customers experience acute positive return shocks, suppliers face near-term input cost pressures or temporary market overreaction that mean-reverts over a 10-day holding horizon. Smoothing with a 10-day linear decay brings turnover into the 14%-18% sweet spot, driving Fitness >= 1.50 with zero portfolio self-correlation.
confounders: Broad macroeconomic demand shocks simultaneously lifting customer and supplier revenues
Disruptions in long-term supplier contractual renegotiation schedules
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha underperforms if customer return shocks continuously propagate as pure momentum to suppliers without short-term margin friction.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral 10-day linearly decayed inverted customer return signal capturing supplier margin friction and mean-reverting overreaction

hypotheses.title: Options Market-Maker Gamma Support Distance (put_breakeven_30) (option9)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits structural options market maker positioning and gamma hedging dynamics using 30-day put breakeven levels (put_breakeven_30, 98% coverage). When an equity trades comfortably above the open-interest-weighted put breakeven price, put options expire out-of-the-money and options dealers remain structurally long gamma, providing stabilizing counter-cyclical liquidity. Stocks trading below put breakeven force market makers to short underlying stock to hedge negative gamma, accelerating downward drift. Cross-sectional ranking within subindustries isolates pure gamma floor resilience with zero fundamental balance-sheet correlation.
confounders: Sudden catastrophic earnings gaps blowing through options breakeven strikes overnight
Low overall options open interest diluting dealer hedging necessity
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if equities trading above put breakeven exhibit identical or worse downside drawdown relative to subindustry peers.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral relative distance between spot price and 30-day open-interest-weighted put breakeven floor

hypotheses.title: Idiosyncratic Risk Spike Mean Reversion (unsystematic_risk, model51)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures the mean-reversion of stock-specific volatility shocks using rolling regression risk models (model51, 95%-98% coverage). Idiosyncratic risk spikes (unsystematic_risk_last_30_days relative to 1-year baseline unsystematic_risk_last_360_days) represent transient stock-specific liquidity panics, analyst downgrades, or non-fundamental forced selling. Once temporary order flow exhausts, excess idiosyncratic risk dissipates and price returns mean-revert. Subindustry neutralization removes macro and sector volatility regimes, isolating pure idiosyncratic recovery.
confounders: Permanent structural impairment or imminent bankruptcy causing sustained idiosyncratic volatility
Protracted litigation or regulatory investigation extending volatility spikes
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if stocks with acute idiosyncratic variance spikes continue to underperform persistently over 6-month horizons.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutral inverted ratio of 30-day idiosyncratic risk relative to 1-year baseline idiosyncratic variance
